summary: Folder management system with nested folders, breadcrumb navigation, and isolated file storage
architectural_notes: Two separate sections: My Files (flat storage) and My Folder (hierarchical storage)
Nested folder structure with unlimited depth
Each folder maintains isolated file storage
Navigation UI includes back button and breadcrumb trail
File uploads scoped to current folder context
known_issues: Folder creation in My Folder section not displaying created folders in file display area
Clicking on created folders does not navigate to folder's file display area
Previous build attempts for folder backend failed

existing_features.title: Implement folder navigation state management tracking current folderId in frontend, allowing users to navigate into folders by clicking them
Add breadcrumb navigation component showing full folder path from root to current location with clickable links to navigate to any ancestor folder
Add back button that navigates to the parent folder of the current location
Ensure file upload functionality works within any folder by passing current folderId to upload operation
Ensure files are isolated to their specific folder location and only appear in the file display when that folder is actively selected
Fix folder creation in My Folder section to properly display newly created folders in the folder list immediately after creation
Maintain separate independent storage areas for My Files section (root-level files with no folder) and My Folder section (organized folder hierarchy)

new_feature_requests.summary: Build complete folder management system with two sections: My Files and My Folder
Implement folder navigation with back button and breadcrumbs showing current path
Enable file upload capability in any folder location
Ensure isolated storage - files remain in their specific folder/section
Fix folder navigation: clicking a folder should switch file display to show that folder's contents
Implement backend folder hierarchy supporting unlimited nesting depth with parent-child relationships tracked via folderId field in folder metadata
Add backend query method to retrieve folder path from root to current folder for breadcrumb display
